name: @builderforce/agent-skills
description: THE Agent Skills (agentskills.io) implementation every BuilderForce surface shares — SKILL.md frontmatter parsing, spec validation (name/description/compatibility/metadata/allowed-tools), skill-folder import + export, and the <available_skills> catalog block. Zero dependencies and no Node builtins: imported by the Worker (cloud), the browser (Brain + Canvas + Studio), Node (agent-runtime) and the VS Code extension host, so a skill means the same thing on every one of them.
